Version 01 / Reference and interpretation

The 26 September concept.

From the design reference

TV console and display shelving, terracotta handwash niche, wood and sage kitchen, charcoal utility, desk/pooja unit, modular library, bedroom wardrobes and dressing units. Material language follows 26 Sep render review.pdf. Page excerpts are below.

Interpretation, not measurement

Reference style: high confidence. Exact placement and dimensions: approximate. The floor plan supplies furniture zones where the PDF lacks a full-room view. Sofas, beds, rug and upholstery are spatial placeholders. Mirrors are non-reflective material proxies, not simulated reflections. No bathroom design was supplied; those rooms remain shells.

Still open in the PDF

Cabinet color swaps, counter depths/divisions, useful TV storage, the library configuration, bedroom sliding doors, wardrobe subdivisions, wallpapers, paints, floors and final dimensions are unresolved review comments. This model does not approve or silently implement them.

A fair comparison

Empty shell removes all concept furniture and finishes. Switching preserves camera, room and wall height. Tall details can be hidden in overview; floor plan hides uppers; walking restores them. Furniture blocks walking only in Designed. If furniture would occupy your current spot, the switch is refused with a message instead of moving your camera. The named version registry can hold later alternatives.

Room mapping

SpacePDF pagesWhat is represented

Interior reference: Crea Projects, supplied by you. Cabinet runs are fitted to the existing traced shell without moving doors or windows. These are illustrative geometry and material studies, not photorealistic renders or procurement drawings. Clearances and fitted dimensions require a measured plan.

The mood: a home with a wink

Cobalt and butter yellow do the talking; coral, pale oak and lilac soften the edges. Rounded furniture, graphic rugs and an original geometric artwork make the everyday feel a little less formal.

The layout: make room for rituals

A listening lounge instead of a TV-first room. A banquette for long breakfasts. A window-side reading chair. A guest room that earns its keep as a game room. These are different uses of the same home, not just new cushion colors.

The tradeoffs are intentional

This is an original idea, not a proposal from the September PDF. The guest double becomes a single daybed; dining becomes a smaller cafe-style arrangement. Fixed walls, windows, doors, kitchen services and the pooja location are retained. Bathrooms and the service balcony remain shells. All furniture sizes and clearances need on-site verification.

Two more directions to imagine

Night Library: ink blue, walnut, amber lighting and a salon-style reading room. Coastal Atelier: chalk white, sea glass, woven textures and a big communal making table. These are future directions, not additional modeled versions.

A new rhythm, room by room

Switch between Casa Pop, the September concept and Empty shell at the same viewpoint. If a new furniture layout occupies your walking position, the viewer asks you to move first. This is a spatial exploration, not a construction or procurement model.
Read the model correctly

A spatial sketch, not a survey.

What follows your plan

The footprint, three bedrooms, study, open drawing/dining area, kitchen, three bathrooms, sit-out, utility, and rear service balcony. Door and window locations are traced visually. Room-size labels reproduce the drawing, not measured model dimensions.

The Empty shell option

No furniture, wardrobes, counters, appliances, or sanitary fixtures in Empty shell. Walls, floor slabs, ceilings, openings, glazing, and balcony guards only. Door leaves are omitted so rooms remain open to explore. Designed adds a separate, removable layer; see Design notes for its reference and assumptions.

Confirmed and inferred measurements

Ceiling: 10 ft, confirmed by you. Plan scale is approximately 28.2 image pixels per foot, cross-checked against bedroom widths. Walls are approximately 150-200 mm thick. Door heads are assumed at 7 ft; typical window sills at 0.9 m and heads at 2.4 m. Guards are 1.05 m. Opening sizes and finishes are illustrative.

One connection needs confirmation

The service balcony's access from inside the house is not legible. No connecting door has been invented. Use the room selector to visit it. Its internal opening is shown as drawn. The kitchen/study divider follows the visible partition line; adjoining cabinetry has been removed.

Overview lowers walls; walkthrough restores their full height and adds ceilings. Walking stays within modeled floor areas and respects walls and fixed glazing. Drawing and dining stay open to each other. The cropped exterior context and external equipment shafts are not reconstructed. Do not use this model for construction, clearances, or purchasing decisions.
